body:
# The Boardroom (Executive Floor)

* **Baseline Capability:** Each Faction maintains **1 Active Open Agenda Slot** and **1 Equippable Perk Slot** on their Faction Dashboard during Step 7 of HQ Downtime.

---

## Sponsorable Modules

| Module Name | Sponsorship Cost | Reward | Passive / Sponsor Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Executive Suite** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | **Agency-Wide:** Expands capacity for every Faction to **2 Active Open Agendas** and **2 Equippable Perks**. |
| **Lobbying Network** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | **Sponsor Benefit:** Once per Downtime, the Sponsor Faction may cycle (discard and redraw) 1 unwanted Agenda or Perk card. |
| **Press Office** | `1 [PIP] + 4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | **Sponsor Benefit:** Whenever **any player** completes an Open Agenda during a mission, the Sponsor Faction collects **`+1 [CR]`** from the bank. |

body:
# The Infirmary (Medical Wing)

* **Baseline Capability:** **2 Treatment Beds**. Each bed provides **3 Healing Dice** to a resting non-deployed operative during Step 3 of HQ Downtime.
* **Healing Resolution:** Every die showing **`5+`** heals `1 missing HP`. Rolling a **natural `1`** calcifies that point of damage into a **Permanent Trauma Token** (`-1 Max HP`, `-1 Starting Static Die`). Any damage remaining unhealed at the end of Step 3 converts into a **Critical Injury Token**.

---

## Sponsorable Modules

Sponsoring any module awards **`+1 [PIP]`** (`2 [VP]`) to the funding Faction and places their Faction Token on the module.

| Module Name | Sponsorship Cost | Reward | Agency-Wide Passive Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Surgical Wing** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Adds **+2 additional Treatment Beds** (4 total beds baseline; 6 during a Stand-Down round). |
| **Trauma Cybernetics** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Upgrades medical lasers: all Healing Dice clear damage on a **`4+`** (and Critical Injury healing improves from `6+` to **`5+`**). |
| **Gene-Stasis Tank** | `1 [PIP] + 3 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Spending **`1 [EF]`** from a Faction Vault during Downtime automatically restores `1 missing HP` without rolling dice (zero risk of natural `1` Permanent Trauma). |

title: Cryo-Stasis Chamber
rules_text: Cost: 2 [PIP] + 6 [CR] (Awards +2 [PIP] to Sponsor). Sponsor-Controlled Landmark (Capacity: 1 Operative). During Downtime Step 3, automatically restores 100% of the occupant's missing HP with 0 dice rolled (0% Permanent Trauma risk). Sponsor chooses occupant or may rent the chamber to rivals.

art_spec.visual_description: A towering cylindrical cryogenic immersion pod frosted with liquid nitrogen vapor, illuminated from within by deep cyan bio-lasers monitoring a suspended operative.

body:
# Cryo-Stasis Chamber (Standalone Landmark)

* **Sponsorship Cost:** `2 [PIP] + 6 [CR]`
* **Sponsorship Reward:** **`+2 [PIP]`** (`4 [VP]`) + Faction Token placement
* **Control Mode:** **Sponsor-Controlled** (`Capacity: 1 Operative`)

---

## Landmark Effect

During **Step 3 (Healing & Medical Recovery)** of HQ Downtime, the chamber holds **1 wounded operative** and **automatically restores 100% of their missing Hit Points** without rolling any Healing Dice (completely eliminating the risk of rolling a natural `1` Permanent Trauma).

Because this Landmark is **Sponsor-Controlled**, the Sponsor Faction decides which operative occupies the pod each round—and may openly auction or rent the slot to desperate rival Factions for `[CR]` or items.

rules_text: Cost: 2 [PIP] + 4 [CR] (Awards +2 [PIP] to Sponsor). Unlocks mid-mission Orbital Drop Pods: during any Transition Step between stages, the Squad Leader may call a supply drop, allowing any deployed operative to purchase and immediately equip face-up Quartermaster items mid-mission.

body:
# Supply Lines (Standalone Landmark)

* **Sponsorship Cost:** `2 [PIP] + 4 [CR]`
* **Sponsorship Reward:** **`+2 [PIP]`** (`4 [VP]`) + Faction Token placement
* **Control Mode:** Agency-Wide Operational Unlock

---

## Landmark Effect

Unlocks mid-mission **Orbital Drop Pods**. During any **Transition Step** between stages on a mission, the **Squad Leader** may call an orbital supply drop, allowing any Factions with deployed operatives to purchase face-up items from the **Quartermaster** display using Vault `[CR]` and equip them immediately in the field.

rules_text: Cost: 2 [PIP] + 5 [CR] (Awards +2 [PIP] to Sponsor). Sponsor-Controlled Landmark (Capacity: 1 Benched Operative). During Downtime, 1 resting operative placed in the simulator gains +1 [LOY] and enters their next mission drop with +2 temporary static dice on Stage 1.

body:
# Tactical Simulator (Standalone Landmark)

* **Sponsorship Cost:** `2 [PIP] + 5 [CR]`
* **Sponsorship Reward:** **`+2 [PIP]`** (`4 [VP]`) + Faction Token placement
* **Control Mode:** **Sponsor-Controlled** (`Capacity: 1 Resting Operative`)

---

## Landmark Effect

During HQ Downtime, **1 healthy benched operative** assigned to the Tactical Simulator immediately earns **`+1 [LOY]`** and enters their next mission deployment with **`+2 temporary static dice` on Stage 1**.

Because this Landmark is **Sponsor-Controlled**, the Sponsor Faction chooses which benched operative trains in the simulator each round (or may lease the training slot to a rival Faction).

body:
# The War Room (Standalone Landmark)

* **Sponsorship Cost:** `2 [PIP] + 2 [CR]`
* **Sponsorship Reward:** **`+2 [PIP]`** (`4 [VP]`) + Faction Token placement
* **Control Mode:** Hybrid (Agency Command Subsidy + Sponsor Perk Dividend)

---

## Landmark Effect

* **Command Subsidy:** The winning bidder in every **Command Auction** receives an immediate **`1 [CR]` refund** from the HQ bank (allowing a `1 [CR]` winning bid to cost `0 [CR]` net).
* **Sponsor Dividend:** Whenever the squad successfully clears a mission, the **Sponsor Faction** draws **`+1 Faction Perk`** card during Debrief.

# The Quartermaster (Armory Vault)

* **Baseline Capability:** **3 Face-Up Item Slots**. Displays Tier 1 Handhelds, Wearables, Consumables, and Complex items at standard `[CR]` prices during Step 6 of HQ Downtime.

---

## Sponsorable Modules

| Module Name | Sponsorship Cost | Reward | Agency-Wide Passive Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Black Market Terminal** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Unlocks **Tier 2** Handhelds, Wearables, Multi-Slot Rigs, Consumables, and Complex items in the Quartermaster deck rotation. |
| **Bulk Logistics** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Expands the shop display to **5 face-up item slots**. Single-use Consumables cost **`-1 [CR]`** (minimum `1 [CR]`). |
| **Custom Workshop** | `1 [PIP] + 3 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Equipping a non-consumable item during Loadout grants that operative **`+1 temporary static die`** on their very first stage roll of the mission. |

title: The Recruitment Bureau (Personnel Division)

modules.title: Headhunter Network
modules.effect: Expands the face-up recruitment market from 2 to 4 available Specialist Operative choices.

modules.title: Signing Bonus Incentives
modules.effect: Reduces operative hiring cost by -2 [CR] (from 8 [CR] down to 6 [CR]). Newly hired recruits immediately draw 1 free random Tier 1 Consumable item.

body:
# The Recruitment Bureau (Personnel Division)

* **Baseline Capability:** **2 Face-Up Recruit Cards**. During Step 5 of HQ Downtime, Factions may pay **`8 Credits [CR]`** to hire an available operative onto their roster bench at full HP and `0 [LOY]`.

---

## Sponsorable Modules

| Module Name | Sponsorship Cost | Reward | Agency-Wide Passive Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Headhunter Network** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Expands the recruitment pool to **4 face-up operative choices**. |
| **Signing Bonus Incentives** | `4 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Reduces operative hiring cost by **`-2 [CR]`** (`6 [CR]` total) and grants 1 free random Tier 1 Consumable upon hiring. |
| **Academy Fast-Track** | `1 [PIP] + 3 [CR]` | `+1 [PIP]` | Newly hired recruits enter the Faction roster with **`+1 starting [LOY]`** (unlocking Loyalty Tier 1 immediately). |
